# trufo_instance (Resource)

A Trufo generator product **instance** — one signing identity within a generator product (`POST /gproduct/instance/*`). Instances hold their own credentials and are issued their own certificates. Requires an active Product Validation on the product.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "trufo_generator_product" "by_name" {
  name = "my-generator-product"
}

resource "trufo_instance" "signing_service" {
  gp_id = data.trufo_generator_product.by_name.id
  name  = "signing-service-eu-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gp_id` (String) Generator product ID (`gp_…`) the instance belongs to. Changing this forces recreation.
- `name` (String) Human-readable instance name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `created_by` (String) Creator of the instance.
- `id` (String) Instance ID (`gpi_…`).
- `oid` (String) Owning organization ID (`org_…`).
- `record_id` (String) Product record ID, embedded in certificates issued to this instance.
